title: THE SOHEI - the warrior monk: the dual prime requisites, the shukenja spell gate with the weapon of choice, the berserk ki and the fanaticism, the command and the commission, the less-strict rules, Tables 29 and 30
audit_comment: OA round twelve (capture pp. 45-47): the sohei - the minima, the ki powers, the command doctrine, and the advancement and spell grids

banner.title: THE SOHEI, printed capture pp. 45-47 - the OA sohei round
banner.provenance: verified against capture pp. 45-47 of the oa.pdf OCR session (single Mistral-OCR capture; cites are capture pages). Two cells settled against the 2018 print BEFORE pinning, per the settling doctrine: the T29 row-4 level cell (the capture prints 3 against four dice; the 2018 prints 4) and the fanaticism roll bonus (the capture prints plus 2; the 2018 prints minus 2, a lost plus against the sustain-himself reading). The T30 row 0 covers the printed levels 1-5 blank row; row k is level k plus 5. The dashes pin as zeros. OCR normalization: 1stlevel reads as 1st-level (prose only)

bools.name: dglSoheiLawfulOnly
bools.comment: Sohei prose (capture p. 46): must be lawful - good, neutral or evil, regardless of the home monastery alignment

bools.name: dglSoheiDualPrime
bools.comment: Sohei prose (capture p. 46): two prime requisites - Strength and Wisdom

bools.name: dglSoheiClericTables
bools.comment: Sohei prose (capture p. 46): the combat and saving throw tables of clerics

bools.name: dglSoheiAnyArmor
bools.comment: Sohei prose (capture p. 46): allowed any armor and the Table 13 weapons

bools.name: dglSoheiCastShukenjaSpells
bools.comment: Sohei prose (capture p. 46): at higher levels casts shukenja spells - only the listed ones, with the same Table 27 bonuses and failure chances

bools.name: dglSoheiMilitant
bools.comment: Sohei prose (capture p. 46): more militant than holy, subject to the leader of the temple, defending the monastery and advancing its claims

bools.name: dglSoheiWeaponChoiceProficiency
bools.comment: Sohei prose (capture p. 47): the weapon of choice must be one with which he already has proficiency

bools.name: dglSoheiKiMissileDeflection
bools.comment: Sohei prose (capture p. 47): in the berserk state he can dodge or deflect missile weapons with a successful save vs breath weapon

bools.name: dglSoheiFanaticFinalAct
bools.comment: Sohei prose (capture p. 47): the fanaticism is a final act - no other actions, then collapse and death, earning posthumous honor

bools.name: dglSoheiCommandReplaceable
bools.comment: Sohei prose (capture p. 47): the fallen in the command are always replaced by additional 1st-level sohei

bools.name: dglSoheiCommandLostIfSlain
bools.comment: Sohei prose (capture p. 47): the command is lost only if all within it other than the commander are slain

bools.name: dglSoheiCommissionCommander
bools.comment: Sohei prose (capture p. 47): the commission makes him the commander of all sohei at the new monastery, still subject to the parent

bools.name: dglSoheiFishAllowed
bools.comment: Sohei prose (capture p. 47): the less-strict rules - no meat but fish is allowed, no excess; no injunction against killing or violence though outright murder is a sin

bools.name: dglSoheiAnyCaste
bools.comment: Sohei prose (capture p. 47): any caste, no Table 38 roll required - the monastery is the new family

bools.name: dglSoheiHonorImportant
bools.comment: Sohei prose (capture p. 47): affected by honor more than a shukenja, but never gains honor for the actions of his monastery

tables.name: dglT29Grid
tables.comment: the Table 29 sohei advancement grid (capture p. 45)
col_comments: the experience column: the upper xp bound of each level, 2,000 at 1st to 950,000 at 12th (capture p. 45).

the accumulated d10 dice column: one per level through 9th, then held at 9 - the row-4 level cell OCR-mangled in the capture (3 against four dice) and settled against the 2018 print as level 4 (capture p. 45).
the hit-point bonus column: the printed 9-plus-N cells - 1 hp per level beyond 9th: 0 through 9th, then 1, 2, 3 (capture p. 45).
tables.audit_comment: the Table 29 grid: the xp bounds and the accumulated dice plus bonus (capture p. 45)

tables.name: dglT30Grid
tables.comment: the Table 30 sohei spells usable by level grid (capture p. 46)
col_comments: the 1st-level spells column: the row 0 levels 1-5 blank, then 1 at 6th to 7 at 29th - the row index is the level minus 5 (capture p. 46).
the 2nd-level spells column: none until 7th, then 1 to 7 at 29th (capture p. 46).
the 3rd-level spells column: none until 10th, then 1 to 6 at 29th (capture p. 46).
the 4th-level spells column: none until 15th, then 1 to 6 at 29th (capture p. 46).
tables.audit_comment: the Table 30 grid: the four spell-level columns, levels 1-29 (capture p. 46)
